from AlgorithmImports import *


class ExactStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    SMA_PERIOD = 200
    RSI_PERIOD = 14
    ALLOCATION = 0.40
    FIXED_BUY_AMOUNT = 20000

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(
            self.spy,
            self.SMA_PERIOD,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            self.RSI_PERIOD,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.SetWarmUp(self.SMA_PERIOD + 1, Resolution.Daily)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def _get_bar(self, data, symbol):
        if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
            return None

        bar = data.Bars[symbol]
        return bar if bar is not None else None

    def _apply_split_adjustments(self, data):
        if data.Splits.ContainsKey(self.spy) and self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            factor = float(data.Splits[self.spy].SplitFactor)
            self.strategy_a_lot = int(round(self.strategy_a_lot * factor))

        if data.Splits.ContainsKey(self.aapl) and self.strategy_b_lot > 0:
            factor = float(data.Splits[self.aapl].SplitFactor)
            self.strategy_b_lot = int(round(self.strategy_b_lot * factor))

    def OnData(self, data):
        self._apply_split_adjustments(data)

        bars = data.Bars
        has_all_bars = all(
            bars.ContainsKey(symbol) and bars[symbol] is not None
            for symbol in self.symbols
        )

        spy_bar = self._get_bar(data, self.spy)
        aapl_bar = self._get_bar(data, self.aapl)

        previous_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
        previous_spy_sma = self.previous_spy_sma
        previous_spy_sma_ready = self.previous_spy_sma_ready

        current_spy_close = None
        current_spy_sma = None

        if spy_bar is not None:
            current_spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)

            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
                current_spy_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)

            self.previous_spy_close = current_spy_close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
            self.previous_spy_sma_ready = current_spy_sma is not None
        else:
            self.previous_spy_close = None
            self.previous_spy_sma = None
            self.previous_spy_sma_ready = False

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            current_aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif current_aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = current_aapl_close
        else:
            current_aapl_close = None
            self.previous_aapl_close = None
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not has_all_bars:
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        spy_crosses_above = (
            current_spy_close is not None
            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma_ready
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close <= previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close > current_spy_sma
        )

        spy_crosses_below = (
            current_spy_close is not None
            and current_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close is not None
            and previous_spy_sma_ready
            and previous_spy_sma is not None
            and previous_spy_close >= previous_spy_sma
            and current_spy_close < current_spy_sma
        )

        aapl_rsi_above_60 = float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60.0

        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            shares = self.strategy_a_lot
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -shares)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and aapl_rsi_above_60:
            shares = self.strategy_b_lot
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -shares)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            target_value = float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * self.ALLOCATION
            shares = int(target_value / current_spy_close)

            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)

            if available_cash >= self.FIXED_BUY_AMOUNT:
                shares = int(self.FIXED_BUY_AMOUNT / current_aapl_close)

                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares
